theme: a seaside cathedral baptistery: pale stone, water and glazed tiles

tiles.prompt: polished terrazzo floor, small white and grey marble chips with a few sea-green chips set in a pale warm-grey cement
hand-glazed square ceramic wall tiles in deep sea-green and turquoise, slightly uneven glossy glaze, thin pale grout lines, about 6 by 6 tiles
honed white Carrara marble with soft grey veins running diagonally
clear shallow water seen from above over pale stone, gentle ripples with bright caustic light patterns
a circular Byzantine floor mosaic medallion centred in the panel: three stylised fish swimming in curling blue and white waves, small gold tesserae ring border, ivory tesserae filling the corners
pale coastal limestone ashlar wall, rectangular blocks in running bond (about 4 courses), fine chisel marks and thin mortar joints
burnished gold leaf over gesso with a punched tooled pattern of small circles and rosettes, slight wear showing red bole
faded medieval fresco ceiling: deep ultramarine blue plaster scattered with small eight-pointed gold stars, soft crackle and patches of worn plaster
a dense layer of frosted sea glass pebbles in aqua, pale green and clear white, tumbled smooth, packed edge to edge
